title: The Gilded Oath
premise: In the free city of Ashfall, where magic was outlawed a generation ago, Sable Pemberton scrapes by selling harmless charms for the Hollow Lantern Guild, the last remnant of a once-great order. When a stranger named Corin Vale walks into his shop, Sable recognizes him from the Guild's oldest relic: a book of prophecies that names this exact night, this exact meeting, and a war that has not yet begun. Corin, it turns out, was pulled across a century by a dying king's desperate spell — and the prophecy binds them together, romantically and catastrophically. To save the free cities from the usurper wearing the king's face, Sable must relearn the forbidden magic his guild abandoned, unbind the true king from the thing that stole his crown, and choose between the gilded oath the prophecy demands and the love he never expected to find. In the end, Sable breaks the prophecy itself rather than fulfill it, freeing Corin from his scripted role at the cost of the Guild's power — and the two of them walk out of the ashes of Ashfall together, unbound and unwritten.
about_author: Coral Thackeray is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing rare occult manuscripts before turning to fiction full-time. She writes lush, character-driven fantasy about ordinary people caught in the machinery of destiny.

chapters.title: The Shop of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. We meet Sable closing up his charm shop in Ashfall, hiding the Guild's last true relic — a prophecy book — beneath the floorboards while magic inspectors patrol outside. A stranger with out-of-era clothing stumbles in, bleeding light. Emotional beat: weary loneliness cracked open by impossible wonder.

chapters.title: A Man Out of His Century
chapters.summary: Alternating Sable and Corin POV. Corin Vale explains he was a royal cartographer in 1823, yanked forward by a spell he didn't cast. Sable opens the prophecy book and finds tonight's date, Corin's arrival, and his own name written a century ago. Emotional beat: vertigo and denial turning into reluctant alliance.

chapters.title: What the Hollow Lantern Kept
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Sable brings Corin to the Guild's crumbling hall, where the last three members reveal the prophecy's full scope: a usurper wearing the true king's face will march on the free cities unless the king is unbound. Emotional beat: grief for a guild that traded its power for survival.

chapters.title: Ink and Interrogation
chapters.summary: Corin's POV. Corin, hunted by the usurper's agents who sensed his arrival, is captured and interrogated; Sable uses a forbidden tracking charm — his first real magic in seven years — to find him. Emotional beat: fear crystallizing into devotion as Sable breaks his own law to save him.

chapters.title: The Road Beneath the Mountains
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Fleeing Ashfall, Sable and Corin travel the old smuggler roads toward the capital, and the prophecy's verses begin describing their growing closeness in unsettling detail. Emotional beat: tenderness shadowed by the dread that their love may be scripted, not chosen.

chapters.title: The Court of the Wearing Crown
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Infiltrating the capital disguised as a charm merchant, they witness the usurper — a thing of smoke and gilding wearing the king's body — hold court. Corin recognizes the true king's consciousness trapped inside. Emotional beat: horror at power's corruption made literal and gleaming.

chapters.title: Seven Years of Ash
chapters.summary: Corin's POV. Corin learns Sable once had real power and burned it out in a magical accident that killed his mentor, which is why the Guild exiled him to selling charms. A bitter argument erupts: can a prophecy trust a man who already failed one oath? Emotional beat: raw honesty as the foundation of real love.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Bargain
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. The usurper offers Sable the Guild's lost power and Corin's safe passage home in exchange for abandoning the unbinding. Sable nearly accepts — the temptation of restored magic, of an easy ending. Emotional beat: the seduction of surrender, refused at terrible cost.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: Dual POV, climax. During the usurper's coronation procession, Sable and Corin — aided by the arriving Guild members and the free cities' hidden mages — perform the unbinding rite. Sable must channel the power he swore never to touch again, and the prophecy demands Corin die to complete it. Emotional beat: sacrificial love defying its own script.

chapters.title: Unwritten
chapters.summary: Sable's POV, resolution. Instead of letting Corin die as foretold, Sable tears the binding page from the prophecy book, breaking the script and the Guild's authority with it. The usurper, unanchored from the prophecy that sustained it, crumbles; the true king, freed, abdicates in favor of the free cities. Emotional beat: quiet triumph — two men walking out of history's pages, choosing each other freely.
